title: Expected Fourier coefficient under random restriction
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$, let $\delta\in\mathbb R$, and let $S\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$. The average over random coordinate restrictions, weighted by $\delta^{|J|}(1-\delta)^{n-|J|}$ with the signs outside $J$ chosen uniformly, of the ambient restriction Fourier coefficient at $S$ equals $\delta^{|S|}$ times the Fourier coefficient of $f$ at $S$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the sign cube of dimension $n$
